reviews.title: Just Starting
reviews.text:
INTVL is pure chaos in the best way possible.
Imagine Pokémon Go, Risk, and your usual running/cycling app had a wild, highly competitive baby — and that baby is out here stealing streets from strangers.
You lace up (or hop on the bike), hit the streets, close a loop, and boom: that chunk of the map is yours. Painted in your color. Until some rival comes through and snatches it right back. Then the notifications start flying, the local battles kick off, and suddenly your “quick easy run” turns into a full-blown territory war.
It’s ridiculously addictive. Every route feels like a heist. Every notification that someone just took your turf is a personal challenge. And the fact that speed doesn’t even matter — just closing those loops — means anyone can play and still feel like a map-dominating legend.
Real prizes, clubs, leaderboards from your neighborhood all the way to the global stage… this thing turns outdoor fitness into the most fun game you’ve played in years.
Download it, claim your first streets, and prepare to become weirdly protective of random blocks in your city. Game on.
